issues.description: The commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java (template) calls farm.feed(), but the problem statement and the solution implement and describe the method as feedAllAnimals(). This name/signature mismatch can confuse students who uncomment the example code and expect the project to compile/run as-is.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use the correct method name feedAllAnimals() (or call addAnimal/feedAllAnimals as shown in the specification), so the example matches the problem statement and solution. Alternatively, adjust the problem text to mention farm.feed() if that name is preferred.

issues.description: The template Main invokes a method named feed() to feed all animals, while the problem statement and the solution use the method name feedAllAnimals(). This mismatched identifier for the same conceptual operation (feeding all animals on the farm) can confuse students and lead to compilation errors or uncertainty about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the identifier consistent: update the template Main to call feedAllAnimals() instead of feed(), or alternatively add a feed() method to Farm that delegates to feedAllAnimals(). Prefer using feedAllAnimals() across template and tests to match the problem statement and solution.
